Technical ask (from CTO call 2026-03-01): p95 end-to-end latency target <200ms for single-turn suggestions at 128 token windows; target throughput ~30 reqs/sec avg, burst to 150.
Model preference: prefer open/Redwood-verified models for cost control; OK to use small fallback models for degraded modes. Interested in quantized variants later.
Security: require SSO for admin console, audit logs for admin actions. Data residency OK in US. No air-gapped/on-prem need now.
Quote from CTO: "We need the assistant to feel like typing with a human — streaming is non-negotiable. Cost per MAU matters."
